name: add-event
label: AddEvent
description: Create and manage calendars, events, and RSVPs with AddEvent — the add-to-calendar service.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
**Authenticate with your AddEvent API key.**

1. Sign in to your AddEvent account at https://dashboard.addevent.com.
2. Open **Account → Settings** (https://dashboard.addevent.com/account/settings).
3. Copy your **API key** and paste it below.

Note: API access requires a paid AddEvent plan — the free Hobby plan does not support the API.

create_event.label: Create Event
create_event.description: Creates a new event on your AddEvent calendar.

datetime_start.label: Start Date/Time
datetime_start.description: Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' (24-hour), interpreted in the event's timezone. Example: 2025-06-15 14:30:00. A date alone (YYYY-MM-DD) is also accepted.

datetime_end.label: End Date/Time
datetime_end.description: Same format as the start. Defaults to one hour after the start.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: The event's timezone. Defaults to the calendar's timezone if left blank.

description.label: Description
description.description: Plain text or HTML (around 500 characters recommended).

location.label: Location
location.description: A physical address or a URL. Leave blank if you set a saved Location ID instead.

location_id.label: Saved Location ID
location_id.description: The ID of a saved location in AddEvent. Use this instead of Location.

organizer_name.label: Organizer Name
organizer_name.description: Required if you set an organizer email.

organizer_email.label: Organizer Email
organizer_email.description: Required if you set an organizer name.

reminder.label: Reminder (minutes before)
reminder.description: Minutes before the event to remind attendees (0–10800).

free_busy.label: Show As
free_busy.description: How the event appears in attendees' calendars.

recurring_rule.label: Recurrence Rule
recurring_rule.description: An iCalendar RRULE, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO. Leave blank for a one-time event.

internal_name.label: Internal Name
internal_name.description: A private label for your reference; not shown to attendees.

landing_page_template_id.label: Landing Page Template ID
landing_page_template_id.description: A custom landing page template ID, or 'default'.

rsvp_form_id.label: RSVP Form ID
rsvp_form_id.description: A custom RSVP form ID, or 'default'. Only used when RSVP is enabled.

update_event.label: Update Event
update_event.description: Updates an event on your AddEvent calendar. Only the fields you fill in are changed.

rsvp_form_id.description: A custom RSVP form ID, or 'default'. Only used when RSVP is enabled.

create_rsvp_attendee.label: Create RSVP Attendee
create_rsvp_attendee.description: Creates a new RSVP attendee on your AddEvent event.

email.label: Email
email.description: The attendee's email address. Event updates and reminders are sent here.

name.label: Name
name.description: The attendee's name (required by the default RSVP form).

notify.label: Send Notification Emails
notify.description: Send a confirmation email to the attendee and a notification to the organizer.

rsvp_form_data.label: Additional Form Fields
rsvp_form_data.description: Extra RSVP form values for custom forms, as key-value pairs. The name is set by the Name field above.

create_add_to_calendar_links.label: Create Dynamic Add to Calendar Links
create_add_to_calendar_links.description: Creates an AddEvent event and returns its shareable "Add to Calendar" links. Opening a link lets recipients add the event to Apple, Google, Outlook, and other calendars. Each run produces a unique link, so links can be personalized per recipient.
